title: Bridging Network Fragmentation: A Semantic-Augmented DRL Framework for UAV-aided VANETs
abstract: arXiv:2603.18871v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Urban Vehicular Ad-Hoc Networks (VANETs) can become fragmented because buildings obstruct wireless links and vehicle mobility continuously changes the network topology. Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) can serve as mobile relays, but Deep Reinforcement Learning (DRL)-based deployment often suffers from inefficient exploration because it lacks road-topology guidance. To address this problem, we propose Semantic-Augmented DRL (SA-DRL), which models network fragmentation over the road topology and aligns a pretrained Large Language Model (LLM) to generate a topology-dependent action prior from dynamic traffic states. The resulting Semantic-Augmented PPO (SA-PPO) algorithm combines this prior with the PPO policy through Logit Fusion, guiding exploration toward promising intersections while retaining adaptation through environmental returns. translated_title: 弥合网络碎片化：一种用于无人机辅助车载自组织网络的语义增强深度强化学习框架
translated_abstract: 城市车载自组织网络（VANETs）可能因建筑物遮挡无线链路以及车辆移动持续改变网络拓扑而变得碎片化。无人机（UAVs）可作为移动中继，但基于深度强化学习（DRL）的部署常因缺乏道路拓扑引导而面临探索效率低下的问题。为解决此问题，我们提出语义增强深度强化学习（SA-DRL），该方法在道路拓扑上建模网络碎片化，并利用预训练的大语言模型（LLM）从动态交通状态生成依赖于拓扑的动作先验。由此产生的语义增强PPO（SA-PPO）算法通过Logit融合将该先验与PPO策略结合，引导探索朝向有前景的交叉口，同时通过环境回报保持适应性。由真实城市轨迹驱动的仿真表明，SA-PPO达到最终收敛结果。
tldr: 提出SA-DRL框架，利用大语言模型生成拓扑感知的动作先验，通过Logit融合增强PPO策略，有效引导无人机部署探索，解决城市VANETs网络碎片化问题。
en_tdlr: The SA-DRL framework leverages a large language model to generate topology-aware action priors, enhancing PPO policy via Logit fusion to guide UAV deployment exploration and address network fragmentation in urban VANETs.
